description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/home_building_1/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/home_building_1/questions.pdf; its answer (6) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class in one room; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.

home_building_1 is a whole apartment split into nine iref regions: 4 = living + dining room, 5 = kitchen, 6 = master bedroom, 7 = bathroom, 8 = second bedroom, 0-3 = the garden outside. Room-scoped questions restrict the selector to the matching region.
The two sofas and the two beds are never named directly: the sofa is identified by the picture wall above it and each bed by its room, matching the phrasing style of the sample questions.

Bottles, spice jars and books are not used as count targets: several kitchen bottles and jars are annotated twice at identical coordinates, and each shelf row of books is a single 'book' object, so none of those numbers matches what a human would count.
Plates are not used either: only three of the four place settings on the dining table have an annotated plate, so the question uses the cups instead.

This scene has no bag recording yet (bags/scenes.yaml skips it), so the iref metadata was copied from /home/ubuntu/myspace/SORT3D/data/IRef-VLA/Unity/home_building_1 into bags/home_building_1/iref_vla_metadata for verification.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the sofa under the pictures?
questions.evidence: Sofa 376 stands against the wooden wall below picture 149 and carries six pillows (54, 59, 300, 310, 368, 382); the second sofa, across the living room, has five.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the dining table?
questions.evidence: Four high-backed chairs (27, 53, 249, 263) surround dining table 266, two on each long side.

questions.question: How many cups are on the dining table?
questions.evidence: Four cups (272, 318, 372, 388) are set out on dining table 266, one at each place setting.

questions.question: How many cups are on the coffee table with the kettle on it?

questions.question: How many speakers are around the TV in the living room?
questions.evidence: Four speakers flank living-room TV 213: tall towers 41 and 208 at the ends and small units 311 and 412 on the stand.

questions.question: How many lamps are in the living room?
questions.evidence: Two matching table lamps (297, 315) stand on the side tables at either end of the sofa under the pictures.

questions.question: How many knives are in the knife rack in the kitchen?

questions.question: How many potted plants are in the living room?

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed in the master bedroom?

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed in the second bedroom?
